Select "Establishment search", choose Bharat Dynamics Limited, Bhanur (Reg. No. E06203600009) and apply.

important_instructions: Applications without the 10th/SSC and ITI mark sheets, or incomplete applications, will not be considered. The uploaded photo and certificates must be clearly visible. BDL may reject a candidature at any stage of selection, and a candidate later found not meeting the eligibility criteria will be rejected and disqualified. Further updates or amendments will appear on bdl-india.in under Apprenticeship Training Notification-2026-27. No other mode of communication will be used.

content_sections.heading: About BDL
content_sections.text: Bharat Dynamics Limited is a Mini Ratna Category-1 Public Sector Enterprise incorporated in 1970 under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The notice describes it as a pioneer in Anti-Tank Guided Missiles, now also making later-generation ATGMs, strategic weapons, launchers, under water weapons, and decoys and test equipment. Its customers are the Indian Army, Indian Air Force and Indian Navy.

content_sections.heading: BDL Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 134 trade-wise vacancies in total. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up. The management reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies as per requirement. Reservations for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS apply as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

content_sections.heading: BDL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Engineering graduates and diploma holders cannot apply under this notification, as a separate apprenticeship scheme applies to them. The Aadhaar number must be entered correctly at registration. Name and date of birth must match the 10th class/SSC certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for the trade-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: BDL Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: A General candidate must be not less than 14 years and not more than 30 years of age. Age is counted as on 30.09.2026.

content_sections.heading: BDL Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit under the Apprentices Act 1961, followed by a medical examination before induction. A list of candidates who applied is drawn separately for each trade. A separate merit list is prepared for each trade from the marks scored in the essential qualification, with equal weightage to 10th/SSC marks and ITI marks. Average marks are calculated as (10th or SSC marks / maximum marks x 0.5 + ITI marks / maximum marks x 0.5) x 100. Selected candidates must pass the prescribed medical examination as per rules in force before induction into the training course.

Fill in personal details, contact details, qualification details (academic and technical) and trade preference details. Upload your latest passport size photo and your date of birth certificate, i.e. 10th class/SSC and ITI mark sheets (compulsory). Scan and upload original certificates only. Click Aadhaar verification and complete the process. After verification the name in the portal cannot be changed. After Apprentice Activation, a system-generated e-mail with your online Registration Number is sent to the e-mail ID you registered. Select "Establishment search", choose Bharat Dynamics Limited, Bhanur (Reg. No. E06203600009) and apply. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BDL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BDL Bhanur Unit has notified 134 apprentice vacancies across 13 ITI trades, including 35 for Fitter, 30 for Electronics Mech. and 22 for COPA.

faq.question: Q2. When do applications start for BDL apprentice 2026-27?
faq.answer: Online applications started on 20-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for BDL ITI apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10th/SSC pass plus ITI pass in the respective trade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: General candidates must be not less than 14 years and not more than 30 years as on 30.09.2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC, and more for PWD categories as listed above.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A separate trade-wise merit list is prepared from 10th/SSC and ITI marks with equal weightage. Selected candidates must pass a medical examination before induction.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BDL Bhanur apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Register on the DGET portal apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, complete Aadhaar verification, then select Bharat Dynamics Limited, Bhanur (Reg. No. E06203600009) under Establishment search and apply.

faq.question: Q8. Can engineering graduates or diploma holders apply?
faq.answer: No. Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible under this notification because a separate apprenticeship scheme applies to them.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The training period for the notified trades is one year as per norms.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for certificate verification?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending certificate verification.
